study type: Combined retrospective and prospective cohort study
exposure: Number of AED used (>1 AED vs 1 AED)
cohort: The study included 55 pregnant women with epilepsy on Anti Epileptic Drugs (AED) and their 55 newborns enrolled from 2017-2020.
finding: Neonatal outcomes were adverse in 58% of babies, and prematurity, low birth weight, and intrauterine growth retardation were significantly associated with mothers using >1 AED or having associated comorbidities.
